description: ICA Sudan, 2018 - Flood Risk, 2013 is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by OCHA Sudan. This layer contains information about the flood risk - by second-level administrative area - estimated during the Integrated Context Analysis (ICA) run in Sudan in 2018. Data sources: UNEP/UNISDR, GAR 2013. Coverage: Sudan. The portal files it under the publisher OCHA Sudan. Its tags are geodata. It offers 1 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2025-08-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-IGO-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
